timingScope: Synchronous offscreen GPUDriven + MaterialResolve; no presentation blit or output/debug readback on timed frames. Checkpoint verification excluded. Not editor presentation FPS.
notes: baseline-detailed is the pre-change implementation with detailed checkpoints; raster enables parallel mesh and phase candidates; priority is the first scheduler draft; final and both pressure runs use the final scheduler with cached admission sort keys.
Routes advance in wall-clock render time. Asynchronous page arrival and selected cuts differ between runs; comparisons are workload measurements, not identical-cut kernel microbenchmarks.
Upload and eviction totals are taken at the last five-second checkpoint, not the end of the final timed frame.
More fine groups or fewer over-target refinement records do not prove 1.5 px convergence. Record counts are cut dependent.
